01 / 项目摘要 01 / Summary

我们不生成内容，我们赋能内容 We don't generate content, we empower it

区别于竞品以 AI 完全替代人类教师的路径，Lemma AI 选择站在全球数百万优质创作者一侧，将静态、孤立的学习资源转化为动态、交互式的个性化学习体验。这一"赋能而非对抗"的战略，使我们的可覆盖市场（TAM）远大于任何 AIGC-only 的竞争者。 Unlike competitors who aim to fully replace human teachers with AI, Lemma AI stands alongside millions of quality content creators worldwide, transforming static, isolated learning resources into dynamic, interactive personalized learning experiences. This "empower rather than compete" strategy gives us a TAM far greater than any AIGC-only competitor.

01

智能课程编排Smart Course Orchestration

AI 检索全网优质学习资源（YouTube、B站、Coursera、PDF、论文等），基于知识图谱和教学法原则，自动编排为体系化、精确到每日任务的个性化课程计划。AI retrieves quality learning resources across the web (YouTube, Bilibili, Coursera, PDFs, papers), and orchestrates them into systematic, day-by-day personalized course plans based on knowledge graphs and pedagogical principles.

02

实时 AI Copilot 伴学Real-time AI Copilot

用户在观看视频课程时可随时暂停并提问。得益于视频级深度语义理解，用户无需补充上下文，可直接引用时间戳提问，获得基于该视频片段的精确解答。Users can pause and ask questions anytime while watching video courses. Thanks to video-level deep semantic understanding, users can reference timestamps directly without adding context, receiving precise answers based on the video segment.

03

AI Native 插件生态AI-Native Plugin Ecosystem

Copilot 不只是一个 ChatBot — 它是一个可扩展的教学工具平台。从英语词汇听写到交互式坐标系画板，通过插件化架构使平台能力无限扩展，覆盖全场景需求。Copilot is not just a ChatBot — it's an extensible teaching tool platform. From English vocabulary dictation to interactive coordinate plane canvases, the plugin architecture enables infinite platform capability expansion across all scenarios.

01 / 项目摘要 01 / Summary

我们不生成内容，我们赋能内容 We don't generate content, we empower it

区别于竞品以 AI 完全替代人类教师的路径，Lemma AI 选择站在全球数百万优质创作者一侧，将静态、孤立的学习资源转化为动态、交互式的个性化学习体验。这一"赋能而非对抗"的战略，使我们的可覆盖市场（TAM）远大于任何 AIGC-only 的竞争者。 Unlike competitors who aim to fully replace human teachers with AI, Lemma AI stands alongside millions of quality content creators worldwide, transforming static, isolated learning resources into dynamic, interactive personalized learning experiences. This "empower rather than compete" strategy gives us a TAM far greater than any AIGC-only competitor.

01

智能课程编排Smart Course Orchestration

AI 检索全网优质学习资源（YouTube、B站、Coursera、PDF、论文等），基于知识图谱和教学法原则，自动编排为体系化、精确到每日任务的个性化课程计划。AI retrieves quality learning resources across the web (YouTube, Bilibili, Coursera, PDFs, papers), and orchestrates them into systematic, day-by-day personalized course plans based on knowledge graphs and pedagogical principles.

02

实时 AI Copilot 伴学Real-time AI Copilot

用户在观看视频课程时可随时暂停并提问。得益于视频级深度语义理解，用户无需补充上下文，可直接引用时间戳提问，获得基于该视频片段的精确解答。Users can pause and ask questions anytime while watching video courses. Thanks to video-level deep semantic understanding, users can reference timestamps directly without adding context, receiving precise answers based on the video segment.

03

AI Native 插件生态AI-Native Plugin Ecosystem

Copilot 不只是一个 ChatBot — 它是一个可扩展的教学工具平台。从英语词汇听写到交互式坐标系画板，通过插件化架构使平台能力无限扩展，覆盖全场景需求。Copilot is not just a ChatBot — it's an extensible teaching tool platform. From English vocabulary dictation to interactive coordinate plane canvases, the plugin architecture enables infinite platform capability expansion across all scenarios.

01 / 项目摘要 01 / Summary

我们不生成内容，我们赋能内容 We don't generate content, we empower it

区别于竞品以 AI 完全替代人类教师的路径，Lemma AI 选择站在全球数百万优质创作者一侧，将静态、孤立的学习资源转化为动态、交互式的个性化学习体验。这一"赋能而非对抗"的战略，使我们的可覆盖市场（TAM）远大于任何 AIGC-only 的竞争者。 Unlike competitors who aim to fully replace human teachers with AI, Lemma AI stands alongside millions of quality content creators worldwide, transforming static, isolated learning resources into dynamic, interactive personalized learning experiences. This "empower rather than compete" strategy gives us a TAM far greater than any AIGC-only competitor.

01

智能课程编排Smart Course Orchestration

AI 检索全网优质学习资源（YouTube、B站、Coursera、PDF、论文等），基于知识图谱和教学法原则，自动编排为体系化、精确到每日任务的个性化课程计划。AI retrieves quality learning resources across the web (YouTube, Bilibili, Coursera, PDFs, papers), and orchestrates them into systematic, day-by-day personalized course plans based on knowledge graphs and pedagogical principles.

02

实时 AI Copilot 伴学Real-time AI Copilot

用户在观看视频课程时可随时暂停并提问。得益于视频级深度语义理解，用户无需补充上下文，可直接引用时间戳提问，获得基于该视频片段的精确解答。Users can pause and ask questions anytime while watching video courses. Thanks to video-level deep semantic understanding, users can reference timestamps directly without adding context, receiving precise answers based on the video segment.

03

AI Native 插件生态AI-Native Plugin Ecosystem

Copilot 不只是一个 ChatBot — 它是一个可扩展的教学工具平台。从英语词汇听写到交互式坐标系画板，通过插件化架构使平台能力无限扩展，覆盖全场景需求。Copilot is not just a ChatBot — it's an extensible teaching tool platform. From English vocabulary dictation to interactive coordinate plane canvases, the plugin architecture enables infinite platform capability expansion across all scenarios.

02 / 产品架构 02 / Product Architecture

四大核心模块，构建完整学习闭环 Four Core Modules, A Complete Learning Loop

从课程编排到实时伴学，从插件生态到 AI 内容生成，Lemma AI 覆盖学习的每一个环节。 From course orchestration to real-time companionship, from plugin ecosystem to AI content generation, Lemma AI covers every aspect of the learning journey.

M1

千人千面的智能课程编排引擎Personalized Course Orchestration Engine

输入用户的学习目标、当前知识水平、可用时间、偏好语言等，AI 检索全网优质学习资源，基于知识图谱和教学法原则，自动编排为体系化、精确到每日任务的个性化课程计划。 Input: learning goals, current knowledge level, available time, language preferences. AI retrieves quality resources across the web and orchestrates them into systematic, day-by-day personalized course plans based on knowledge graphs and pedagogical principles.

01 / 项目摘要 01 / Summary

我们不生成内容，我们赋能内容 We don't generate content, we empower it

区别于竞品以 AI 完全替代人类教师的路径，Lemma AI 选择站在全球数百万优质创作者一侧，将静态、孤立的学习资源转化为动态、交互式的个性化学习体验。这一"赋能而非对抗"的战略，使我们的可覆盖市场（TAM）远大于任何 AIGC-only 的竞争者。 Unlike competitors who aim to fully replace human teachers with AI, Lemma AI stands alongside millions of quality content creators worldwide, transforming static, isolated learning resources into dynamic, interactive personalized learning experiences. This "empower rather than compete" strategy gives us a TAM far greater than any AIGC-only competitor.

01

智能课程编排Smart Course Orchestration

AI 检索全网优质学习资源（YouTube、B站、Coursera、PDF、论文等），基于知识图谱和教学法原则，自动编排为体系化、精确到每日任务的个性化课程计划。AI retrieves quality learning resources across the web (YouTube, Bilibili, Coursera, PDFs, papers), and orchestrates them into systematic, day-by-day personalized course plans based on knowledge graphs and pedagogical principles.

02

实时 AI Copilot 伴学Real-time AI Copilot

用户在观看视频课程时可随时暂停并提问。得益于视频级深度语义理解，用户无需补充上下文，可直接引用时间戳提问，获得基于该视频片段的精确解答。Users can pause and ask questions anytime while watching video courses. Thanks to video-level deep semantic understanding, users can reference timestamps directly without adding context, receiving precise answers based on the video segment.

03

AI Native 插件生态AI-Native Plugin Ecosystem

Copilot 不只是一个 ChatBot — 它是一个可扩展的教学工具平台。从英语词汇听写到交互式坐标系画板，通过插件化架构使平台能力无限扩展，覆盖全场景需求。Copilot is not just a ChatBot — it's an extensible teaching tool platform. From English vocabulary dictation to interactive coordinate plane canvases, the plugin architecture enables infinite platform capability expansion across all scenarios.

M1

千人千面的智能课程编排引擎Personalized Course Orchestration Engine

输入用户的学习目标、当前知识水平、可用时间、偏好语言等，AI 检索全网优质学习资源，基于知识图谱和教学法原则，自动编排为体系化、精确到每日任务的个性化课程计划。 Input: learning goals, current knowledge level, available time, language preferences. AI 检索全网优质学习资源（YouTube、B站、Coursera、PDF、论文等），基于知识图谱和教学法原则，自动编排为体系化、精确到每日任务的个性化课程计划。AI retrieves quality learning resources across the web (YouTube, Bilibili, Coursera, PDFs, papers), and orchestrates them into systematic, day-by-day personalized course plans based on knowledge graphs and pedagogical principles.

02

实时 AI Copilot 伴学Real-time AI Copilot

用户在观看视频课程时可随时暂停并提问。得益于视频级深度语义理解，用户无需补充上下文，可直接引用时间戳提问，获得基于该视频片段的精确解答。Users can pause and ask questions anytime while watching video courses. Thanks to video-level deep semantic understanding, users can reference timestamps directly without adding context, receiving precise answers based on the video segment.

03

AI Native 插件生态AI-Native Plugin Ecosystem

Copilot 不只是一个 ChatBot — 它是一个可扩展的教学工具平台。从英语词汇听写到交互式坐标系画板，通过插件化架构使平台能力无限扩展，覆盖全场景需求。Copilot is not just a ChatBot — it's an extensible teaching tool platform. From English vocabulary dictation to interactive coordinate plane canvases, the plugin architecture enables infinite platform capability expansion across all scenarios.

02 / 产品架构 02 / Product Architecture

四大核心模块，构建完整学习闭环 Four Core Modules, A Complete Learning Loop

从课程编排到实时伴学，从插件生态到 AI 内容生成，Lemma AI 覆盖学习的每一个环节。 From course orchestration to real-time companionship, from plugin ecosystem to AI content generation, Lemma AI covers every aspect of the learning journey.

M1

千人千面的智能课程编排引擎Personalized Course Orchestration Engine

输入用户的学习目标、当前知识水平、可用时间、偏好语言等，AI 检索全网优质学习资源，基于知识图谱和教学法原则，自动编排为体系化、精确到每日任务的个性化课程计划。 Input: learning goals, current knowledge level, available time, language preferences. AI retrieves quality resources across the web and orchestrates them into systematic, day-by-day personalized course plans based on knowledge graphs and pedagogical principles.

输出类 Coursera 体验的完整课程 — 每一课包含教学视频、讲义/幻灯片、课后小测、笔记模板、作业。若用户未在预定时间内完成某单元，系统自动动态重排后续课程日程。 Output: Coursera-style complete courses — each lesson includes teaching videos, notes/slides, quizzes, note templates, and assignments. If a user falls behind schedule, the system automatically reschedules subsequent lessons.

M2

实时 AI Copilot 伴学Real-time AI Copilot

用户在观看视频课程时，可随时暂停并在右侧 Copilot 交互区提问。关键技术差异：得益于底层对视频内容的深度语义理解，用户无需补充任何上下文，可直接引用时间戳提问。 Users can pause anytime and ask questions in the Copilot panel. Key technical differentiation: thanks to deep semantic understanding of video content, users can reference timestamps directly without providing additional context.

延伸能力：AI 基于对整套课程及用户个人学习画像的理解，主动识别薄弱知识点（如用户多次就同一概念提问、反复倒退进度条），并针对性生成强化练习、笔记和小测。 Extended capability: AI identifies weak knowledge points based on understanding of the entire course and user learning profile (e.g., repeated questions on the same concept, frequent rewinding), and generates targeted reinforcement exercises, notes, and quizzes.

M3

AI Native 插件市场AI-Native Plugin Marketplace

Copilot 不只是一个 ChatBot — 它是一个可扩展的教学工具平台。英语词汇场景调用"单词听写"插件、数学场景调用"交互式坐标系画板"、文科场景调用古诗/课文默写插件、通用场景 Lemma AI — 智能学习平台 | AI-Native Learning Platform

01 / 项目摘要 01 / Summary

我们不生成内容，我们赋能内容 We don't generate content, we empower it

区别于竞品以 AI 完全替代人类教师的路径，Lemma AI 选择站在全球数百万优质创作者一侧，将静态、孤立的学习资源转化为动态、交互式的个性化学习体验。这一"赋能而非对抗"的战略，使我们的可覆盖市场（TAM）远大于任何 AIGC-only 的竞争者。 Unlike competitors who aim to fully replace human teachers with AI, Lemma AI stands alongside millions of quality content creators worldwide, transforming static, isolated learning resources into dynamic, interactive personalized learning experiences. This "empower rather than compete" strategy gives us a TAM far greater than any AIGC-only competitor.

01

智能课程编排Smart Course Orchestration

AI 检索全网优质学习资源（YouTube、B站、Coursera、PDF、论文等），基于知识图谱和教学法原则，自动编排为体系化、精确到每日任务的个性化课程计划。AI retrieves quality learning resources across the web (YouTube, Bilibili, Coursera, PDFs, papers), and orchestrates them into systematic, day-by-day personalized course plans based on knowledge graphs and pedagogical principles.

02

实时 AI Copilot 伴学Real-time AI Copilot

用户在观看视频课程时可随时暂停并提问。得益于视频级深度语义理解，用户无需补充上下文，可直接引用时间戳提问，获得基于该视频片段的精确解答。Users can pause and ask questions anytime while watching video courses. Thanks to video-level deep semantic understanding, users can reference timestamps directly without adding context, receiving precise answers based on the video segment.

03

AI Native 插件生态AI-Native Plugin Ecosystem

Copilot 不只是一个 ChatBot — 它是一个可扩展的教学工具平台。从英语词汇听写到交互式坐标系画板，通过插件化架构使平台能力无限扩展，覆盖全场景需求。Copilot is not just a ChatBot — it's an extensible teaching tool platform. From English vocabulary dictation to interactive coordinate plane canvases, the plugin architecture enables infinite platform capability expansion across all scenarios.

02 / 产品架构 02 / Product Architecture

四大核心模块，构建完整学习闭环 Four Core Modules, A Complete Learning Loop

从课程编排到实时伴学，从插件生态到 AI 内容生成，Lemma AI 覆盖学习的每一个环节。 From course orchestration to real-time companionship, from plugin ecosystem to AI content generation, Lemma AI covers every aspect of the learning journey.

M1

千人千面的智能课程编排引擎Personalized Course Orchestration Engine

输入用户的学习目标、当前知识水平、可用时间、偏好语言等，AI 检索全网优质学习资源，基于知识图谱和教学法原则，自动编排为体系化、精确到每日任务的个性化课程计划。 Input: learning goals, current knowledge level, available time, language preferences. AI retrieves quality resources across the web and orchestrates them into systematic, day-by-day personalized course plans based on knowledge graphs and pedagogical principles.

输出类 Coursera 体验的完整课程 — 每一课包含教学视频、讲义/幻灯片、课后小测、笔记模板、作业。若用户未在预定时间内完成某单元，系统自动动态重排后续课程日程。 Output: Coursera-style complete courses — each lesson includes teaching videos, notes/slides, quizzes, note templates, and assignments. If a user falls behind schedule, the system automatically reschedules subsequent lessons.

M2

实时 AI Copilot 伴学Real-time AI Copilot

用户在观看视频课程时，可随时暂停并在右侧 Copilot 交互区提问。关键技术差异：得益于底层对视频内容的深度语义理解，用户无需补充任何上下文，可直接引用时间戳提问。 Users can pause anytime and ask questions in the Copilot panel. Key technical differentiation: thanks to deep semantic understanding of video content, users can reference timestamps directly without providing additional context.

延伸能力：AI 基于对整套课程及用户个人学习画像的理解，主动识别薄弱知识点（如用户多次就同一概念提问、反复倒退进度条），并针对性生成强化练习、笔记和小测。 Extended capability: AI identifies weak knowledge points based on understanding of the entire course and user learning profile (e.g., repeated questions on the same concept, frequent rewinding), and generates targeted reinforcement exercises, notes, and quizzes.

M3

AI Native 插件市场AI-Native Plugin Marketplace

Copilot 不只是一个 ChatBot — 它是一个可扩展的教学工具平台。英语词汇场景调用"单词听写"插件、数学场景调用"交互式坐标系画板"、文科场景调用古诗/课文默写插件、通用场景支持多题型自动生成。 Copilot is not just a ChatBot — it's an extensible teaching tool platform. English vocabulary triggers dictation plugins, math scenarios trigger interactive coordinate canvases, humanities trigger poetry/text dictation, and universal scenarios support multi-format question generation.

开放生态（规划中）：后续开放 Plugin 开发规范，允许第三方开发者和教育创作者共建插件市场 — 形成"内容生态 + Lemma AI — 智能学习平台 | AI-Native Learning Platform

Copilot 不只是一个 ChatBot — 它是一个可扩展的教学工具平台。从英语词汇听写到交互式坐标系画板，通过插件化架构使平台能力无限扩展，覆盖全场景需求。Copilot is not just a ChatBot — it's an extensible teaching tool platform. From English vocabulary dictation to interactive coordinate plane canvases, the plugin architecture enables infinite platform capability expansion across all scenarios.

02 / 产品架构 02 / Product Architecture

四大核心模块，构建完整学习闭环 Four Core Modules, A Complete Learning Loop

从课程编排到实时伴学，从插件生态到 AI 内容生成，Lemma AI 覆盖学习的每一个环节。 From course orchestration to real-time companionship, from plugin ecosystem to AI content generation, Lemma AI covers every aspect of the learning journey.

M1

千人千面的智能课程编排引擎Personalized Course Orchestration Engine

输入用户的学习目标、当前知识水平、可用时间、偏好语言等，AI 检索全网优质学习资源，基于知识图谱和教学法原则，自动编排为体系化、精确到每日任务的个性化课程计划。 Input: learning goals, current knowledge level, available time, language preferences. AI retrieves quality resources across the web and orchestrates them into systematic, day-by-day personalized course plans based on knowledge graphs and pedagogical principles.

输出类 Coursera 体验的完整课程 — 每一课包含教学视频、讲义/幻灯片、课后小测、笔记模板、作业。若用户未在预定时间内完成某单元，系统自动动态重排后续课程日程。 Output: Coursera-style complete courses — each lesson includes teaching videos, notes/slides, quizzes, note templates, and assignments. If a user falls behind schedule, the system automatically reschedules subsequent lessons.

M2

实时 AI Copilot 伴学Real-time AI Copilot

用户在观看视频课程时，可随时暂停并在右侧 Copilot 交互区提问。关键技术差异：得益于底层对视频内容的深度语义理解，用户无需补充任何上下文，可直接引用时间戳提问。 Users can pause anytime and ask questions in the Copilot panel. Key technical differentiation: thanks to deep semantic understanding of video content, users can reference timestamps directly without providing additional context.

延伸能力：AI 基于对整套课程及用户个人学习画像的理解，主动识别薄弱知识点（如用户多次就同一概念提问、反复倒退进度条），并针对性生成强化练习、笔记和小测。 Extended capability: AI identifies weak knowledge points based on understanding of the entire course and user learning profile (e.g., repeated questions on the same concept, frequent rewinding), and generates targeted reinforcement exercises, notes, and quizzes.

M3

AI Native 插件市场AI-Native Plugin Marketplace

Copilot 不只是一个 ChatBot — 它是一个可扩展的教学工具平台。英语词汇场景调用"单词听写"插件、数学场景调用"交互式坐标系画板"、文科场景调用古诗/课文默写插件、通用场景支持多题型自动生成。 Copilot is not just a ChatBot — it's an extensible teaching tool platform. English vocabulary triggers dictation plugins, math scenarios trigger interactive coordinate canvases, humanities trigger poetry/text dictation, and universal scenarios support multi-format question generation.

开放生态（规划中）：后续开放 Plugin 开发规范，允许第三方开发者和教育创作者共建插件市场 — 形成"内容生态 + 工具生态"双飞轮。 Open ecosystem (planned): Plugin development specs will be released, allowing third-party developers and educational creators to co-build the marketplace — forming a "content ecosystem + tool ecosystem" dual flywheel.

M4

完整的 AI Native 生态Complete Lemma AI — 智能学习平台 | AI-Native Learning Platform

01 / 项目摘要 01 / Summary

我们不生成内容，我们赋能内容 We don't generate content, we empower it

区别于竞品以 AI 完全替代人类教师的路径，Lemma AI 选择站在全球数百万优质创作者一侧，将静态、孤立的学习资源转化为动态、交互式的个性化学习体验。这一"赋能而非对抗"的战略，使我们的可覆盖市场（TAM）远大于任何 AIGC-only 的竞争者。 Unlike competitors who aim to fully replace human teachers with AI, Lemma AI stands alongside millions of quality content creators worldwide, transforming static, isolated learning resources into dynamic, interactive personalized learning experiences. This "empower rather than compete" strategy gives us a TAM far greater than any AIGC-only competitor.

01

智能课程编排Smart Course Orchestration

AI 检索全网优质学习资源（YouTube、B站、Coursera、PDF、论文等），基于知识图谱和教学法原则，自动编排为体系化、精确到每日任务的个性化课程计划。AI retrieves quality learning resources across the web (YouTube, Bilibili, Coursera, PDFs, papers), and orchestrates them into systematic, day-by-day personalized course plans based on knowledge graphs and pedagogical principles.

02

实时 AI Copilot 伴学Real-time AI Copilot

用户在观看视频课程时可随时暂停并提问。得益于视频级深度语义理解，用户无需补充上下文，可直接引用时间戳提问，获得基于该视频片段的精确解答。Users can pause and ask questions anytime while watching video courses. Thanks to video-level deep semantic understanding, users can reference timestamps directly without adding context, receiving precise answers based on the video segment.

03

AI Native 插件生态AI-Native Plugin Ecosystem

Copilot 不只是一个 ChatBot — 它是一个可扩展的教学工具平台。从英语词汇听写到交互式坐标系画板，通过插件化架构使平台能力无限扩展，覆盖全场景需求。Copilot is not just a ChatBot — it's an extensible teaching tool platform. From English vocabulary dictation to interactive coordinate plane canvases, the plugin architecture enables infinite platform capability expansion across all scenarios.

AI retrieves quality resources across the web and orchestrates them into systematic, day-by-day personalized course plans based on knowledge graphs and pedagogical principles.

If a user falls behind schedule, the system automatically reschedules subsequent lessons.

01 / 项目摘要 01 / Summary

我们不生成内容，我们赋能内容 We don't generate content, we empower it

区别于竞品以 AI 完全替代人类教师的路径，Lemma AI 选择站在全球数百万优质创作者一侧，将静态、孤立的学习资源转化为动态、交互式的个性化学习体验。这一"赋能而非对抗"的战略，使我们的可覆盖市场（TAM）远大于任何 AIGC-only 的竞争者。 Unlike competitors who aim to fully replace human teachers with AI, Lemma AI stands alongside millions of quality content creators worldwide, transforming static, isolated learning resources into dynamic, interactive personalized learning experiences. This "empower rather than compete" strategy gives us a TAM far greater than any AIGC-only competitor.

01

智能课程编排Smart Course Orchestration

AI 检索全网优质学习资源（YouTube、B站、Coursera、PDF、论文等），基于知识图谱和教学法原则，自动编排为体系化、精确到每日任务的个性化课程计划。AI retrieves quality learning resources across the web (YouTube, Bilibili, Coursera, PDFs, papers), and orchestrates them into systematic, day-by-day personalized course plans based on knowledge graphs and pedagogical principles.

02

实时 AI Copilot 伴学Real-time AI Copilot

用户在观看视频课程时可随时暂停并提问。得益于视频级深度语义理解，用户无需补充上下文，可直接引用时间戳提问，获得基于该视频片段的精确解答。Users can pause and ask questions anytime while watching video courses. Thanks to video-level deep semantic understanding, users can reference timestamps directly without adding context, receiving precise answers based on the video segment.

03

AI Native 插件生态AI-Native Plugin Ecosystem

Copilot 不只是一个 ChatBot — 它是一个可扩展的教学工具平台。从英语词汇听写到交互式坐标系画板，通过插件化架构使平台能力无限扩展，覆盖全场景需求。Copilot is not just a ChatBot — it's an extensible teaching tool platform. From English vocabulary dictation to interactive coordinate plane canvases, the plugin architecture enables infinite platform capability expansion across all scenarios.

02 / 产品架构 02 / Product Architecture

四大核心模块，构建完整学习闭环 Four Core Modules, A Complete Learning Loop

从课程编排到实时伴学，从插件生态到 AI 内容生成，Lemma AI 覆盖学习的每一个环节。 From course orchestration to real-time companionship, from plugin ecosystem to AI content generation, Lemma AI covers every aspect of the learning journey.

M1

千人千面的智能课程编排引擎Personalized Course Orchestration Engine

输入用户的学习目标、当前知识水平、可用时间、偏好语言等，AI 检索全网优质学习资源，基于知识图谱和教学法原则，自动编排为体系化、精确到每日任务的个性化课程计划。 Input: learning goals, current knowledge level, available time, language preferences. AI retrieves quality resources across the web and orchestrates them into systematic, day-by-day personalized course plans based on knowledge graphs and pedagogical principles.

输出类 Coursera 体验的完整课程 — 每一课包含教学视频、讲义/幻灯片、课后小测、笔记模板、作业。若用户未在预定时间内完成某单元，系统自动动态重排后续课程日程。 Output: Coursera-style complete courses — each lesson includes teaching videos, notes/slides, quizzes, note templates, and assignments. If a user falls behind schedule, the system automatically reschedules subsequent lessons.

M2

实时 AI Copilot 伴学Real-time AI Copilot

用户在观看视频课程时，可随时暂停并在右侧 Copilot 交互区提问。关键技术差异：得益于底层对视频内容的深度语义理解，用户无需补充任何上下文，可直接引用时间戳提问。 Users can pause anytime and ask questions in the Copilot panel. Key technical differentiation: thanks to deep semantic understanding of video content, users can reference timestamps directly without providing additional context.

延伸能力：AI 基于对整套课程及用户个人学习画像的理解，主动识别薄弱知识点（如用户多次就同一概念提问、反复倒退进度条），并针对性生成强化练习、笔记和小测。 Extended capability: AI identifies weak knowledge points based on understanding of the entire course and user learning profile (e.g., repeated questions on the same concept, frequent rewinding), and generates targeted reinforcement exercises, notes, and quizzes.

M3

AI Native 插件市场AI-Native Plugin Marketplace

Copilot 不只是一个 ChatBot — 它是一个可扩展的教学工具平台。英语词汇场景调用"单词听写"插件、数学场景调用"交互式坐标系画板"、文科场景调用古诗/课文默写插件、通用场景支持多题型自动生成。 Copilot is not just a ChatBot — it's an extensible teaching tool platform. English vocabulary triggers dictation plugins, math scenarios trigger interactive coordinate canvases, humanities trigger poetry/text dictation, and universal scenarios support multi-format question generation.

English vocabulary triggers dictation plugins, math scenarios trigger interactive coordinate canvases, humanities trigger poetry/text dictation, and universal scenarios support multi-format question generation.

开放生态（规划中）：后续开放 Plugin 开发规范，允许第三方开发者和教育创作者共建插件市场 — 形成"内容生态 + 工具生态"双飞轮。 Open ecosystem (planned): Plugin development specs will be released, allowing third-party developers and educational creators to co-build the marketplace — forming a "content ecosystem + tool ecosystem" dual flywheel.

M4

完整的 AI Native 生态Complete AI-Native Ecosystem

得益于 AI 对整套课程及用户个人画像的理解，AI 不仅可以找到最适合用户的学习课程和路径，还可以针对用户的痛点、薄弱点、知识本身的重点、易忘点等核心信息进行针对性的内容生成。 With AI's understanding of the entire course curriculum and the user's personal profile, it not only finds the most suitable learning paths but also generates targeted content addressing user pain points, weak areas, key knowledge points, and easily forgotten concepts.

例如用户对知识点 A 掌握薄弱，在观看课程时多次提问并倒退进度条反复观看，则 AI 可针对该知识点生成具有针对性小测、笔记和作业，辅助用户更牢固地掌握知识。 For example, if a user struggles with concept A, asking multiple questions and rewinding repeatedly, AI generates targeted quizzes, notes, and assignments for that specific concept to help the user master it more solidly.

01 / 项目摘要 01 / Summary

我们不生成内容，我们赋能内容 We don't generate content, we empower it

区别于竞品以 AI 完全替代人类教师的路径，Lemma AI 选择站在全球数百万优质创作者一侧，将静态、孤立的学习资源转化为动态、交互式的个性化学习体验。这一"赋能而非对抗"的战略，使我们的可覆盖市场（TAM）远大于任何 AIGC-only 的竞争者。 Unlike competitors who aim to fully replace human teachers with AI, Lemma AI stands alongside millions of quality content creators worldwide, transforming static, isolated learning resources into dynamic, interactive personalized learning experiences. This "empower rather than compete" strategy gives us a TAM far greater than any AIGC-only competitor.

01

智能课程编排Smart Course Orchestration

AI 检索全网优质学习资源（YouTube、B站、Coursera、PDF、论文等），基于知识图谱和教学法原则，自动编排为体系化、精确到每日任务的个性化课程计划。AI retrieves quality learning resources across the web (YouTube, Bilibili, Coursera, PDFs, papers), and orchestrates them into systematic, day-by-day personalized course plans based on knowledge graphs and pedagogical principles.

02

实时 AI Copilot 伴学Real-time AI Copilot

用户在观看视频课程时可随时暂停并提问。得益于视频级深度语义理解，用户无需补充上下文，可直接引用时间戳提问，获得基于该视频片段的精确解答。Users can pause and ask questions anytime while watching video courses. Thanks to video-level deep semantic understanding, users can reference timestamps directly without adding context, receiving precise answers based on the video segment.

03

AI Native 插件生态AI-Native Plugin Ecosystem

Copilot 不只是一个 ChatBot — 它是一个可扩展的教学工具平台。从英语词汇听写到交互式坐标系画板，通过插件化架构使平台能力无限扩展，覆盖全场景需求。Copilot is not just a ChatBot — it's an extensible teaching tool platform. From English vocabulary dictation to interactive coordinate plane canvases, the plugin architecture enables infinite platform capability expansion across all scenarios.

02 / 产品架构 02 / Product Architecture

四大核心模块，构建完整学习闭环 Four Core Modules, A Complete Learning Loop

从课程编排到实时伴学，从插件生态到 AI 内容生成，Lemma AI 覆盖学习的每一个环节。 From course orchestration to real-time companionship, from plugin ecosystem to AI content generation, Lemma AI covers every aspect of the learning journey.

M1

千人千面的智能课程编排引擎Personalized Course Orchestration Engine

输入用户的学习目标、当前知识水平、可用时间、偏好语言等，AI 检索全网优质学习资源，基于知识图谱和教学法原则，自动编排为体系化、精确到每日任务的个性化课程计划。 Input: learning goals, current knowledge level, available time, language preferences. AI retrieves quality resources across the web and orchestrates them into systematic, day-by-day personalized course plans based on knowledge graphs and pedagogical principles.

输出类 Coursera 体验的完整课程 — 每一课包含教学视频、讲义/幻灯片、课后小测、笔记模板、作业。若用户未在预定时间内完成某单元，系统自动动态重排后续课程日程。 Output: Coursera-style complete courses — each lesson includes teaching videos, notes/slides, quizzes, note templates, and assignments. If a user falls behind schedule, the system automatically reschedules subsequent lessons.

M2

实时 AI Copilot 伴学Real-time AI Copilot

用户在观看视频课程时，可随时暂停并在右侧 Copilot 交互区提问。关键技术差异：得益于底层对视频内容的深度语义理解，用户无需补充任何上下文，可直接引用时间戳提问。 Users can pause anytime and ask questions in the Copilot panel. Key technical differentiation: thanks to deep semantic understanding of video content, users can reference timestamps directly without providing additional context.

延伸能力：AI 基于对整套课程及用户个人学习画像的理解，主动识别薄弱知识点（如用户多次就同一概念提问、反复倒退进度条），并针对性生成强化练习、笔记和小测。 Extended capability: AI identifies weak knowledge points based on understanding of the entire course and user learning profile (e.g., repeated questions on the same concept, frequent rewinding), and generates targeted reinforcement exercises, notes, and quizzes.

M3

AI Native 插件市场AI-Native Plugin Marketplace

Copilot 不只是一个 ChatBot — 它是一个可扩展的教学工具平台。英语词汇场景调用"单词听写"插件、数学场景调用"交互式坐标系画板"、文科场景调用古诗/课文默写插件、通用场景支持多题型自动生成。 Copilot is not just a ChatBot — it's an extensible teaching tool platform. English vocabulary triggers dictation plugins, math scenarios trigger interactive coordinate canvases, humanities trigger poetry/text dictation, and universal scenarios support multi-format question generation.

开放生态（规划中）：后续开放 Plugin 开发规范，允许第三方开发者和教育创作者共建插件市场 — 形成"内容生态 + 工具生态"双飞轮。 Open ecosystem (planned): Plugin development specs will be released, allowing third-party developers and educational creators to co-build the marketplace — forming a "content ecosystem + tool ecosystem" dual flywheel.

M4

延伸能力：AI 基于对整套课程及用户个人学习画像的理解，主动识别薄弱知识点（如用户多次就同一概念提问、反复倒退进度条），并针对性生成强化练习、笔记和小测。 Extended capability: AI identifies weak knowledge points based on understanding of the entire course and user learning profile (e.g., repeated questions on the same concept, frequent rewinding), and generates targeted reinforcement exercises, notes, and quizzes.

M3

AI Native 插件市场AI-Native Plugin Marketplace

Copilot 不只是一个 ChatBot — 它是一个可扩展的教学工具平台。英语词汇场景调用"单词听写"插件、数学场景调用"交互式坐标系画板"、文科场景调用古诗/课文默写插件、通用场景支持多题型自动生成。 Copilot is not just a ChatBot — it's an extensible teaching tool platform. English vocabulary triggers dictation plugins, math scenarios trigger interactive coordinate canvases, humanities trigger poetry/text dictation, and universal scenarios support multi-format question generation.

开放生态（规划中）：后续开放 Plugin 开发规范，允许第三方开发者和教育创作者共建插件市场 — 形成"内容生态 + 工具生态"双飞轮。 Open ecosystem (planned): Plugin development specs will be released, allowing third-party developers and educational creators to co-build the marketplace — forming a "content ecosystem + tool ecosystem" dual flywheel.

M4

完整的 AI Native 生态Complete AI-Native Ecosystem

得益于 AI 对整套课程及用户个人画像的理解，AI 不仅可以找到最适合用户的学习课程和路径，还可以针对用户的痛点、薄弱点、知识本身的重点、易忘点等核心信息进行针对性的内容生成。 With AI's understanding of the entire course curriculum and the user's personal profile, it not only finds the most suitable learning paths but also generates targeted content addressing user pain points, weak areas, key knowledge points, and easily forgotten concepts.

例如用户对知识点 A 掌握薄弱，在观看课程时多次提问并倒退进度条反复观看，则 AI 可针对该知识点生成具有针对性小测、笔记和作业，辅助用户更牢固地掌握知识。 For example, if a user struggles with concept A, asking multiple questions and rewinding repeatedly, AI generates targeted quizzes, notes, and assignments for that specific concept to help the user master it more solidly.

M1

千人千面的智能课程编排引擎Personalized Course Orchestration Engine

输入用户的学习目标、当前知识水平、可用时间、偏好语言等，AI 检索全网优质学习资源，基于知识图谱和教学法原则，自动编排为体系化、精确到每日任务的个性化课程计划。 Input: learning goals, current knowledge level, available time, language preferences. AI retrieves quality resources across the web and orchestrates them into systematic, day-by-day personalized course plans based on knowledge graphs and pedagogical principles.

输出类 Coursera 体验的完整课程 — 每一课包含教学视频、讲义/幻灯片、课后小测、笔记模板、作业。若用户未在预定时间内完成某单元，系统自动动态重排后续课程日程。 Output: Coursera-style complete courses — each lesson includes teaching videos, notes/slides, quizzes, note templates, and assignments. If a user falls behind schedule, the system automatically reschedules subsequent lessons.

M2

实时 AI Copilot 伴学Real-time AI Copilot

用户在观看视频课程时，可随时暂停并在右侧 Copilot 交互区提问。关键技术差异：得益于底层对视频内容的深度语义理解，用户无需补充任何上下文，可直接引用时间戳提问。 Users can pause anytime and ask questions in the Copilot panel. Key technical differentiation: thanks to deep semantic understanding of video content, users can reference timestamps directly without providing additional context.

延伸能力：AI 基于对整套课程及用户个人学习画像的理解，主动识别薄弱知识点（如用户多次就同一概念提问、反复倒退进度条），并针对性生成强化练习、笔记和小测。 Extended capability: AI identifies weak knowledge points based on understanding of the entire course and user learning profile (e.g., repeated questions on the same concept, frequent rewinding), and generates targeted reinforcement exercises, notes, and quizzes.

M3

AI Native 插件市场AI-Native Plugin Marketplace

Copilot 不只是一个 ChatBot — 它是一个可扩展的教学工具平台。英语词汇场景调用"单词听写"插件、数学场景调用"交互式坐标系画板"、文科场景调用古诗/课文默写插件、通用场景支持多题型自动生成。 Copilot is not just a ChatBot — it's an extensible teaching tool platform. English vocabulary triggers dictation plugins, math scenarios trigger interactive coordinate canvases, humanities trigger poetry/text dictation, and universal scenarios support multi-format question generation.

开放生态（规划中）：后续开放 Plugin 开发规范，允许第三方开发者和教育创作者共建插件市场 — 形成"内容生态 + 工具生态"双飞轮。 Open ecosystem (planned): Plugin development specs will be released, allowing third-party developers and educational creators to co-build the marketplace — forming a "content ecosystem + tool ecosystem" dual flywheel.

M4

完整的 AI Native 生态Complete AI-Native Ecosystem

得益于 AI 对整套课程及用户个人画像的理解，AI 不仅可以找到最适合用户的学习课程和路径，还可以针对用户的痛点、薄弱点、知识本身的重点、易忘点等核心信息进行针对性的内容生成。 With AI's understanding of the entire course curriculum and the user's personal profile, it not only finds the most suitable learning paths but also generates targeted content addressing user pain points, weak areas, key knowledge points, and easily forgotten concepts.

例如用户对知识点 A 掌握薄弱，在观看课程时多次提问并倒退进度条反复观看，则 AI 可针对该知识点生成具有针对性小测、笔记和作业，辅助用户更牢固地掌握知识。 For example, if a user struggles with concept A, asking multiple questions and rewinding repeatedly, AI generates targeted quizzes, notes, and assignments for that specific concept to help the user master it more solidly.

03 / 战略差异化 03 / Strategic Differentiation

AIGC-Only vs. AI-Augmented：行业范式之争 AIGC-Only vs. AI-Augmented: The Paradigm Divide

当前 AI 教育赛道存在两条截然不同的路径。路径 A 以 AI 完全替代人类教师；路径 B 以 AI 赋能人类内容。Lemma AI 坚定选择路径 B。 Two fundamentally different paths exist in AI education. Path A replaces human teachers entirely with AI; Path B empowers human content with AI. Lemma AI firmly chooses Path B.

区别于竞品以 AI 完全替代人类教师的路径，Lemma AI 选择站在全球数百万优质创作者一侧，将静态、孤立的学习资源转化为动态、交互式的个性化学习体验。这一"赋能而非对抗"的战略，使我们的可覆盖市场（TAM）远大于任何 AIGC-only 的竞争者。 Unlike competitors who aim to fully replace human teachers with AI, Lemma AI stands alongside millions of quality content creators worldwide, transforming static, isolated learning resources into dynamic, interactive personalized learning experiences. This "empower rather than compete" strategy gives us a TAM far greater than any AIGC-only competitor.

用户在观看视频课程时可随时暂停并提问。得益于视频级深度语义理解，用户无需补充上下文，可直接引用时间戳提问，获得基于该视频片段的精确解答。Users can pause and ask questions anytime while watching video courses. Thanks to video-level deep semantic understanding, users can reference timestamps directly without adding context, receiving precise answers based on the video segment.

03

AI Native 插件生态AI-Native Plugin Ecosystem

Copilot 不只是一个 ChatBot — 它是一个可扩展的教学工具平台。从英语词汇听写到交互式坐标系画板，通过插件化架构使平台能力无限扩展，覆盖全场景需求。Copilot is not just a ChatBot — it's an extensible teaching tool platform. From English vocabulary dictation to interactive coordinate plane canvases, the plugin architecture enables infinite platform capability expansion across all scenarios.

02 / 产品架构 02 / Product Architecture

四大核心模块，构建完整学习闭环 Four Core Modules, A Complete Learning Loop

从课程编排到实时伴学，从插件生态到 AI 内容生成，Lemma AI 覆盖学习的每一个环节。 From course orchestration to real-time companionship, from plugin ecosystem to AI content generation, Lemma AI covers every aspect of the learning journey.

M1

千人千面的智能课程编排引擎Personalized Course Orchestration Engine

输入用户的学习目标、当前知识水平、可用时间、偏好语言等，AI 检索全网优质学习资源，基于知识图谱和教学法原则，自动编排为体系化、精确到每日任务的个性化课程计划。 Input: learning goals, current knowledge level, available time, language preferences. AI retrieves quality resources across the web and orchestrates them into systematic, day-by-day personalized course plans based on knowledge graphs and pedagogical principles.

输出类 Coursera 体验的完整课程 — 每一课包含教学视频、讲义/幻灯片、课后小测、笔记模板、作业。若用户未在预定时间内完成某单元，系统自动动态重排后续课程日程。 Output: Coursera-style complete courses — each lesson includes teaching videos, notes/slides, quizzes, note templates, and assignments. If a user falls behind schedule, the system automatically reschedules subsequent lessons.

M2

实时 AI Copilot 伴学Real-time AI Copilot

用户在观看视频课程时，可随时暂停并在右侧 Copilot 交互区提问。关键技术差异：得益于底层对视频内容的深度语义理解，用户无需补充任何上下文，可直接引用时间戳提问。 Users can pause anytime and ask questions in the Copilot panel. Key technical differentiation: thanks to deep semantic understanding of video content, users can reference timestamps directly without providing additional context.

延伸能力：AI 基于对整套课程及用户个人学习画像的理解，主动识别薄弱知识点（如用户多次就同一概念提问、反复倒退进度条），并针对性生成强化练习、笔记和小测。 Extended capability: AI identifies weak knowledge points based on understanding of the entire course and user learning profile (e.g., repeated questions on the same concept, frequent rewinding), and generates targeted reinforcement exercises, notes, and quizzes.

M3

AI Native 插件市场AI-Native Plugin Marketplace

Copilot 不只是一个 ChatBot — 它是一个可扩展的教学工具平台。英语词汇场景调用"单词听写"插件、数学场景调用"交互式坐标系画板"、文科场景调用古诗/课文默写插件、通用场景支持多题型自动生成。 Copilot is not just a ChatBot — it's an extensible teaching tool platform. English vocabulary triggers dictation plugins, math scenarios trigger interactive coordinate canvases, humanities trigger poetry/text dictation, and universal scenarios support multi-format question generation.

开放生态（规划中）：后续开放 Plugin 开发规范，允许第三方开发者和教育创作者共建插件市场 — 形成"内容生态 + 工具生态"双飞轮。 Open ecosystem (planned): Plugin development specs will be released, allowing third-party developers and educational creators to co-build the marketplace — forming a "content ecosystem + tool ecosystem" dual flywheel.

M4

完整的 AI Native 生态Complete AI-Native Ecosystem

得益于 AI 对整套课程及用户个人画像的理解，AI 不仅可以找到最适合用户的学习课程和路径，还可以针对用户的痛点、薄弱点、知识本身的重点、易忘点等核心信息进行针对性的内容生成。 With AI's understanding of the entire course curriculum and the user's personal profile, it not only finds the most suitable learning paths but also generates targeted content addressing user pain points, weak areas, key knowledge points, and easily forgotten concepts.

例如用户对知识点 A 掌握薄弱，在观看课程时多次提问并倒退进度条反复观看，则 AI 可针对该知识点生成具有针对性小测、笔记和作业，辅助用户更牢固地掌握知识。 For example, if a user struggles with concept A, asking multiple questions and rewinding repeatedly, AI generates targeted quizzes, notes, and assignments for that specific concept to help the user master it more solidly.

03 / 战略差异化 03 / Strategic Differentiation

AIGC-Only vs. AI-Augmented：行业范式之争 AIGC-Only vs. AI-Augmented: The Paradigm Divide

当前 AI 教育赛道存在两条截然不同的路径。路径 A 以 AI 完全替代人类教师；路径 B 以 AI 赋能人类内容。Lemma AI 坚定选择路径 B。 Two fundamentally different paths exist in AI education. Path A replaces human teachers entirely with AI; Path B empowers human content with AI. Lemma AI firmly chooses Path B.

维度Dimension 路径 A：AIGC-OnlyPath A: AIGC-Only 路径 B：AI-Augmented（Lemma AI）Path B: AI-Augmented (Lemma AI)
核心 Lemma AI — 智能学习平台 | AI-Native Learning Platform

01 / 项目摘要 01 / Summary

我们不生成内容，我们赋能内容 We don't generate content, we empower it

区别于竞品以 AI 完全替代人类教师的路径，Lemma AI 选择站在全球数百万优质创作者一侧，将静态、孤立的学习资源转化为动态、交互式的个性化学习体验。这一"赋能而非对抗"的战略，使我们的可覆盖市场（TAM）远大于任何 AIGC-only 的竞争者。 Unlike competitors who aim to fully replace human teachers with AI, Lemma AI stands alongside millions of quality content creators worldwide, transforming static, isolated learning resources into dynamic, interactive personalized learning experiences. This "empower rather than compete" strategy gives us a TAM far greater than any AIGC-only competitor.

01

智能课程编排Smart Course Orchestration

AI 检索全网优质学习资源（YouTube、B站、Coursera、PDF、论文等），基于知识图谱和教学法原则，自动编排为体系化、精确到每日任务的个性化课程计划。AI retrieves quality learning resources across the web (YouTube, Bilibili, Coursera, PDFs, papers), and orchestrates them into systematic, day-by-day personalized course plans based on knowledge graphs and pedagogical principles.

02

实时 AI Copilot 伴学Real-time AI Copilot

用户在观看视频课程时可随时暂停并提问。得益于视频级深度语义理解，用户无需补充上下文，可直接引用时间戳提问，获得基于该视频片段的精确解答。Users can pause and ask questions anytime while watching video courses. Thanks to video-level deep semantic understanding, users can reference timestamps directly without adding context, receiving precise answers based on the video segment.

03

AI Native 插件生态AI-Native Plugin Ecosystem

Copilot 不只是一个 ChatBot — 它是一个可扩展的教学工具平台。从英语词汇听写到交互式坐标系画板，通过插件化架构使平台能力无限扩展，覆盖全场景需求。Copilot is not just a ChatBot — it's an extensible teaching tool platform. From English vocabulary dictation to interactive coordinate plane canvases, the plugin architecture enables infinite platform capability expansion across all scenarios.

02 / 产品架构 02 / Product Architecture

四大核心模块，构建完整学习闭环 Four Core Modules, A Complete Learning Loop

从课程编排到实时伴学，从插件生态到 AI 内容生成，Lemma AI 覆盖学习的每一个环节。 From course orchestration to real-time companionship, from plugin ecosystem to AI content generation, Lemma AI covers every aspect of the learning journey.

M1

千人千面的智能课程编排引擎Personalized Course Orchestration Engine

输入用户的学习目标、当前知识水平、可用时间、偏好语言等，AI 检索全网优质学习资源，基于知识图谱和教学法原则，自动编排为体系化、精确到每日任务的个性化课程计划。 Input: learning goals, current knowledge level, available time, language preferences. AI retrieves quality resources across the web and orchestrates them into systematic, day-by-day personalized course plans based on knowledge graphs and pedagogical principles.

输出类 Coursera 体验的完整课程 — 每一课包含教学视频、讲义/幻灯片、课后小测、笔记模板、作业。若用户未在预定时间内完成某单元，系统自动动态重排后续课程日程。 Output: Coursera-style complete courses — each lesson includes teaching videos, notes/slides, quizzes, note templates, and assignments. If a user falls behind schedule, the system automatically reschedules subsequent lessons.

M2

实时 AI Copilot 伴学Real-time AI Copilot

用户在观看视频课程时，可随时暂停并在右侧 Copilot 交互区提问。关键技术差异：得益于底层对视频内容的深度语义理解，用户无需补充任何上下文，可直接引用时间戳提问。 Users can pause anytime and ask questions in the Copilot panel. Key technical differentiation: thanks to deep semantic understanding of video content, users can reference timestamps directly without providing additional context.

延伸能力：AI 基于对整套课程及用户个人学习画像的理解，主动识别薄弱知识点（如用户多次就同一概念提问、反复倒退进度条），并针对性生成强化练习、笔记和小测。 Extended capability: AI identifies weak knowledge points based on understanding of the entire course and user learning profile (e.g., repeated questions on the same concept, frequent rewinding), and generates targeted reinforcement exercises, notes, and quizzes.

M3

AI Native 插件市场AI-Native Plugin Marketplace

Copilot 不只是一个 ChatBot — 它是一个可扩展的教学工具平台。英语词汇场景调用"单词听写"插件、数学场景调用"交互式坐标系画板"、文科场景调用古诗/课文默写插件、通用场景支持多题型自动生成。 Copilot is not just a ChatBot — it's an extensible teaching tool platform. English vocabulary triggers dictation plugins, math scenarios trigger interactive coordinate canvases, humanities trigger poetry/text dictation, and universal scenarios support multi-format question generation.

开放生态（规划中）：后续开放 Plugin 开发规范，允许第三方开发者和教育创作者共建插件市场 — 形成"内容生态 + 工具生态"双飞轮。 Open ecosystem (planned): Plugin development specs will be released, allowing third-party developers and educational creators to co-build the marketplace — forming a "content ecosystem + tool ecosystem" dual flywheel.

M4

完整的 AI Native 生态Complete AI-Native Ecosystem

得益于 AI 对整套课程及用户个人画像的理解，AI 不仅可以找到最适合用户的学习课程和路径，还可以针对用户的痛点、薄弱点、知识本身的重点、易忘点等核心信息进行针对性的内容生成。 With AI's understanding of the entire course curriculum and the user's personal profile, it not only finds the most suitable learning paths but also generates targeted content addressing user pain points, weak areas, key knowledge points, and easily forgotten concepts.

例如用户对知识点 A 掌握薄弱，在观看课程时多次提问并倒退进度条反复观看，则 AI 可针对该知识点生成具有针对性小测、笔记和作业，辅助用户更牢固地掌握知识。 For example, if a user struggles with concept A, asking multiple questions and rewinding repeatedly, AI generates targeted quizzes, notes, and assignments for that specific concept to help the user master it more solidly.

03 / 战略差异化 03 / Strategic Differentiation

AIGC-Only vs. AI-Augmented：行业范式之争 AIGC-Only vs. AI-Augmented: The Paradigm Divide

当前 AI 教育赛道存在两条截然不同的路径。路径 A 以 AI 完全替代人类教师；路径 B 以 AI 赋能人类内容。Lemma AI 坚定选择路径 B。 Two fundamentally different paths exist in AI education. Path A replaces human teachers entirely with AI; Path B empowers human content with AI. Lemma AI firmly chooses Path B.

维度Dimension 路径 A：AIGC-OnlyPath A: AIGC-Only 路径 B：AI-Augmented（Lemma AI）Path B: AI-Augmented (Lemma AI)
核心逻辑Core Logic 用 AI 替代人类教师，完全生成教学内容Replace human teachers with AI, fully generate content 以全球优质人类创作内容为基底，用 AI 将其转化为个性化交互体验 Lemma AI — 智能学习平台 | AI-Native Learning Platform

Copilot 不只是一个 ChatBot — 它是一个可扩展的教学工具平台。英语词汇场景调用"单词听写"插件、数学场景调用"交互式坐标系画板"、文科场景调用古诗/课文默写插件、通用场景支持多题型自动生成。 Copilot is not just a ChatBot — it's an extensible teaching tool platform. English vocabulary triggers dictation plugins, math scenarios trigger interactive coordinate canvases, humanities trigger poetry/text dictation, and universal scenarios support multi-format question generation.

开放生态（规划中）：后续开放 Plugin 开发规范，允许第三方开发者和教育创作者共建插件市场 — 形成"内容生态 + 工具生态"双飞轮。 Open ecosystem (planned): Plugin development specs will be released, allowing third-party developers and educational creators to co-build the marketplace — forming a "content ecosystem + tool ecosystem" dual flywheel.

M4

完整的 AI Native 生态Complete AI-Native Ecosystem

得益于 AI 对整套课程及用户个人画像的理解，AI 不仅可以找到最适合用户的学习课程和路径，还可以针对用户的痛点、薄弱点、知识本身的重点、易忘点等核心信息进行针对性的内容生成。 With AI's understanding of the entire course curriculum and the user's personal profile, it not only finds the most suitable learning paths but also generates targeted content addressing user pain points, weak areas, key knowledge points, and easily forgotten concepts.

例如用户对知识点 A 掌握薄弱，在观看课程时多次提问并倒退进度条反复观看，则 AI 可针对该知识点生成具有针对性小测、笔记和作业，辅助用户更牢固地掌握知识。 For example, if a user struggles with concept A, asking multiple questions and rewinding repeatedly, AI generates targeted quizzes, notes, and assignments for that specific concept to help the user master it more solidly.

03 / 战略差异化 03 / Strategic Differentiation

AIGC-Only vs. AI-Augmented：行业范式之争 AIGC-Only vs. AI-Augmented: The Paradigm Divide

01 / 项目摘要 01 / Summary

我们不生成内容，我们赋能内容 We don't generate content, we empower it

区别于竞品以 AI 完全替代人类教师的路径，Lemma AI 选择站在全球数百万优质创作者一侧，将静态、孤立的学习资源转化为动态、交互式的个性化学习体验。这一"赋能而非对抗"的战略，使我们的可覆盖市场（TAM）远大于任何 AIGC-only 的竞争者。 Unlike competitors who aim to fully replace human teachers with AI, Lemma AI stands alongside millions of quality content creators worldwide, transforming static, isolated learning resources into dynamic, interactive personalized learning experiences. This "empower rather than compete" strategy gives us a TAM far greater than any AIGC-only competitor.

01

智能课程编排Smart Course Orchestration

AI 检索全网优质学习资源（YouTube、B站、Coursera、PDF、论文等），基于知识图谱和教学法原则，自动编排为体系化、精确到每日任务的个性化课程计划。AI retrieves quality learning resources across the web (YouTube, Bilibili, Coursera, PDFs, papers), and orchestrates them into systematic, day-by-day personalized course plans based on knowledge graphs and pedagogical principles.

02

实时 AI Copilot 伴学Real-time AI Copilot

用户在观看视频课程时可随时暂停并提问。得益于视频级深度语义理解，用户无需补充上下文，可直接引用时间戳提问，获得基于该视频片段的精确解答。Users can pause and ask questions anytime while watching video courses. Thanks to video-level deep semantic understanding, users can reference timestamps directly without adding context, receiving precise answers based on the video segment.

03

AI Native 插件生态AI-Native Plugin Ecosystem

Copilot 不只是一个 ChatBot — 它是一个可扩展的教学工具平台。从英语词汇听写到交互式坐标系画板，通过插件化架构使平台能力无限扩展，覆盖全场景需求。Copilot is not just a ChatBot — it's an extensible teaching tool platform. From English vocabulary dictation to interactive coordinate plane canvases, the plugin architecture enables infinite platform capability expansion across all scenarios.

02 / 产品架构 02 / Product Architecture

四大核心模块，构建完整学习闭环 Four Core Modules, A Complete Learning Loop

从课程编排到实时伴学，从插件生态到 AI 内容生成，Lemma AI 覆盖学习的每一个环节。 From course orchestration to real-time companionship, from plugin ecosystem to AI content generation, Lemma AI covers every aspect of the learning journey.

M1

千人千面的智能课程编排引擎Personalized Course Orchestration Engine

输入用户的学习目标、当前知识水平、可用时间、偏好语言等，AI 检索全网优质学习资源，基于知识图谱和教学法原则，自动编排为体系化、精确到每日任务的个性化课程计划。 Input: learning goals, current knowledge level, available time, language preferences. AI retrieves quality resources across the web and orchestrates them into systematic, day-by-day personalized course plans based on knowledge graphs and pedagogical principles.

输出类 Coursera 体验的完整课程 — 每一课包含教学视频、讲义/幻灯片、课后小测、笔记模板、作业。若用户未在预定时间内完成某单元，系统自动动态重排后续课程日程。 Output: Coursera-style complete courses — each lesson includes teaching videos, notes/slides, quizzes, note templates, and assignments. If a user falls behind schedule, the system automatically reschedules subsequent lessons.

M2

实时 AI Copilot 伴学Real-time AI Copilot

用户在观看视频课程时，可随时暂停并在右侧 Copilot 交互区提问。关键技术差异：得益于底层对视频内容的深度语义理解，用户无需补充任何上下文，可直接引用时间戳提问。 Users can pause anytime and ask questions in the Copilot panel. Key technical differentiation: thanks to deep semantic understanding of video content, users can reference timestamps directly without providing additional context.

延伸能力：AI 基于对整套课程及用户个人学习画像的理解，主动识别薄弱知识点（如用户多次就同一概念提问、反复倒退进度条），并针对性生成强化练习、笔记和小测。 Extended capability: AI identifies weak knowledge points based on understanding of the entire course and user learning profile (e.g., repeated questions on the same concept, frequent rewinding), and generates targeted reinforcement exercises, notes, and quizzes.

M3

AI Native 插件市场AI-Native Plugin Marketplace

Copilot 不只是一个 ChatBot — 它是一个可扩展的教学工具平台。从英语词汇听写到交互式坐标系画板，通过插件化架构使平台能力无限扩展，覆盖全场景需求。Copilot is not just a ChatBot — it's an extensible teaching tool platform. From English vocabulary dictation to interactive coordinate plane canvases, the plugin architecture enables infinite platform capability expansion across all scenarios.

02 / 产品架构 02 / Product Architecture

四大核心模块，构建完整学习闭环 Four Core Modules, A Complete Learning Loop

从课程编排到实时伴学，从插件生态到 AI 内容生成，Lemma AI 覆盖学习的每一个环节。 From course orchestration to real-time companionship, from plugin ecosystem to AI content generation, Lemma AI covers every aspect of the learning journey.

M1

千人千面的智能课程编排引擎Personalized Course Orchestration Engine

输入用户的学习目标、当前知识水平、可用时间、偏好语言等，AI 检索全网优质学习资源，基于知识图谱和教学法原则，自动编排为体系化、精确到每日任务的个性化课程计划。 Input: learning goals, current knowledge level, available time, language preferences. AI retrieves quality resources across the web and orchestrates them into systematic, day-by-day personalized course plans based on knowledge graphs and pedagogical principles.

输出类 Coursera 体验的完整课程 — 每一课包含教学视频、讲义/幻灯片、课后小测、笔记模板、作业。若用户未在预定时间内完成某单元，系统自动动态重排后续课程日程。 Output: Coursera-style complete courses — each lesson includes teaching videos, notes/slides, quizzes, note templates, and assignments. If a user falls behind schedule, the system automatically reschedules subsequent lessons.

M2

实时 AI Copilot 伴学Real-time AI Copilot

用户在观看视频课程时，可随时暂停并在右侧 Copilot 交互区提问。关键技术差异：得益于底层对视频内容的深度语义理解，用户无需补充任何上下文，可直接引用时间戳提问。 Users can pause anytime and ask questions in the Copilot panel. Key technical differentiation: thanks to deep semantic understanding of video content, users can reference timestamps directly without providing additional context.

延伸能力：AI 基于对整套课程及用户个人学习画像的理解，主动识别薄弱知识点（如用户多次就同一概念提问、反复倒退进度条），并针对性生成强化练习、笔记和小测。 Extended capability: AI identifies weak knowledge points based on understanding of the entire course and user learning profile (e.g., repeated questions on the same concept, frequent rewinding), and generates targeted reinforcement exercises, notes, and quizzes.

M3

AI Native 插件市场AI-Native Plugin Marketplace

Copilot 不只是一个 ChatBot — 它是一个可扩展的教学工具平台。英语词汇场景调用"单词听写"插件、数学场景调用"交互式坐标系画板"、文科场景调用古诗/课文默写插件、通用场景支持多题型自动生成。 Copilot is not just a ChatBot — it's an extensible teaching tool platform. English vocabulary triggers dictation plugins, math scenarios trigger interactive coordinate canvases, humanities trigger poetry/text dictation, and universal scenarios support multi-format question generation.

开放生态（规划中）：后续开放 Plugin 开发规范，允许第三方开发者和教育创作者共建插件市场 — 形成"内容生态 + 工具生态"双飞轮。 Open ecosystem (planned): Plugin development specs will be released, allowing third-party developers and educational creators to co-build the marketplace — forming a "content ecosystem + tool ecosystem" dual flywheel.

M4

完整的 AI Native 生态Complete AI-Native Ecosystem

得益于 AI 对整套课程及用户个人画像的理解，AI 不仅可以找到最适合用户的学习课程和路径，还可以针对用户的痛点、薄弱点、知识本身的重点、易忘点等核心信息进行针对性的内容生成。 With AI's understanding of the entire course curriculum and the user's personal profile, it not only finds the most suitable learning paths but also generates targeted content addressing user pain points, weak areas, key knowledge points, and easily forgotten concepts.

例如用户对知识点 A 掌握薄弱，在观看课程时多次提问并倒退进度条反复观看，则 AI 可针对该知识点生成具有针对性小测、笔记和作业，辅助用户更牢固地掌握知识。 For example, if a user struggles with concept A, asking multiple questions and rewinding repeatedly, AI generates targeted quizzes, notes, and assignments for that specific concept to help the user master it more solidly.

03 / 战略差异化 03 / Strategic Differentiation

AIGC-Only vs. AI-Augmented：行业范式之争 AIGC-Only vs. AI-Augmented: The Paradigm Divide

当前 AI 教育赛道存在两条截然不同的路径。路径 A 以 AI 完全替代人类教师；路径 B 以 AI 赋能人类内容。Lemma AI 坚定选择路径 B。 Two fundamentally different paths exist in AI education. Path A replaces human teachers entirely with AI; Path B empowers human content with AI. Lemma AI firmly chooses Path B.

01 / 项目摘要 01 / Summary

我们不生成内容，我们赋能内容 We don't generate content, we empower it

区别于竞品以 AI 完全替代人类教师的路径，Lemma AI 选择站在全球数百万优质创作者一侧，将静态、孤立的学习资源转化为动态、交互式的个性化学习体验。这一"赋能而非对抗"的战略，使我们的可覆盖市场（TAM）远大于任何 AIGC-only 的竞争者。 Unlike competitors who aim to fully replace human teachers with AI, Lemma AI stands alongside millions of quality content creators worldwide, transforming static, isolated learning resources into dynamic, interactive personalized learning experiences. This "empower rather than compete" strategy gives us a TAM far greater than any AIGC-only competitor.

01

智能课程编排Smart Course Orchestration

AI 检索全网优质学习资源（YouTube、B站、Coursera、PDF、论文等），基于知识图谱和教学法原则，自动编排为体系化、精确到每日任务的个性化课程计划。AI retrieves quality learning resources across the web (YouTube, Bilibili, Coursera, PDFs, papers), and orchestrates them into systematic, day-by-day personalized course plans based on knowledge graphs and pedagogical principles.

02

实时 AI Copilot 伴学Real-time AI Copilot

用户在观看视频课程时可随时暂停并提问。得益于视频级深度语义理解，用户无需补充上下文，可直接引用时间戳提问，获得基于该视频片段的精确解答。Users can pause and ask questions anytime while watching video courses. Thanks to video-level deep semantic understanding, users can reference timestamps directly without adding context, receiving precise answers based on the video segment.

03

AI Native 插件生态AI-Native Plugin Ecosystem

Copilot 不只是一个 ChatBot — 它是一个可扩展的教学工具平台。从英语词汇听写到交互式坐标系画板，通过插件化架构使平台能力无限扩展，覆盖全场景需求。Copilot is not just a ChatBot — it's an extensible teaching tool platform. From English vocabulary dictation to interactive coordinate plane canvases, the plugin architecture enables infinite platform capability expansion across all scenarios.

02 / 产品架构 02 / Product Architecture

四大核心模块，构建完整学习闭环 Four Core Modules, A Complete Learning Loop

从课程编排到实时伴学，从插件生态到 AI 内容生成，Lemma AI 覆盖学习的每一个环节。 From course orchestration to real-time companionship, from plugin ecosystem to AI content generation, Lemma AI covers every aspect of the learning journey.

M1

千人千面的智能课程编排引擎Personalized Course Orchestration Engine

输入用户的学习目标、当前知识水平、可用时间、偏好语言等，AI 检索全网优质学习资源，基于知识图谱和教学法原则，自动编排为体系化、精确到每日任务的个性化课程计划。 Input: learning goals, current knowledge level, available time, language preferences. AI retrieves quality resources across the web and orchestrates them into systematic, day-by-day personalized course plans based on knowledge graphs and pedagogical principles.

输出类 Coursera 体验的完整课程 — 每一课包含教学视频、讲义/幻灯片、课后小测、笔记模板、作业。若用户未在预定时间内完成某单元，系统自动动态重排后续课程日程。 Output: Coursera-style complete courses — each lesson includes teaching videos, notes/slides, quizzes, note templates, and assignments. If a user falls behind schedule, the system automatically reschedules subsequent lessons.

M2

实时 AI Copilot 伴学Real-time AI Copilot

用户在观看视频课程时，可随时暂停并在右侧 Copilot 交互区提问。关键技术差异：得益于底层对视频内容的深度语义理解，用户无需补充任何上下文，可直接引用时间戳提问。 Users can pause anytime and ask questions in the Copilot panel. Key technical differentiation: thanks to deep semantic understanding of video content, users can reference timestamps directly without providing additional context.

延伸能力：AI 基于对整套课程及用户个人学习画像的理解，主动识别薄弱知识点（如用户多次就同一概念提问、反复倒退进度条），并针对性生成强化练习、笔记和小测。 Extended capability: AI identifies weak knowledge points based on understanding of the entire course and user learning profile (e.g., repeated questions on the same concept, frequent rewinding), and generates targeted reinforcement exercises, notes, and quizzes.

M3

AI Native 插件市场AI-Native Plugin Marketplace

Copilot 不只是一个 ChatBot — 它是一个可扩展的教学工具平台。英语词汇场景调用"单词听写"插件、数学场景调用"交互式坐标系画板"、文科场景调用古诗/课文默写插件、通用场景支持多题型自动生成。 Copilot is not just a ChatBot — it's an extensible teaching tool platform. English vocabulary triggers dictation plugins, math scenarios trigger interactive coordinate canvases, humanities trigger poetry/text dictation, and universal scenarios support multi-format question generation.

开放生态（规划中）：后续开放 Plugin 开发规范，允许第三方开发者和教育创作者共建插件市场 — 形成"内容生态 + 工具生态"双飞轮。 Open ecosystem (planned): Plugin development specs will be released, allowing third-party developers and educational creators to co-build the marketplace — forming a "content ecosystem + tool ecosystem" dual flywheel.

M4

完整的 AI Native 生态Complete AI-Native Ecosystem

得益于 AI 对整套课程及用户个人画像的理解，AI 不仅可以找到最适合用户的学习课程和路径，还可以针对用户的痛点、薄弱点、知识本身的重点、易忘点等核心信息进行针对性的内容生成。 With AI's understanding of the entire course curriculum and the user's personal profile, it not only finds the most suitable learning paths but also generates targeted content addressing user pain points, weak areas, key knowledge points, and easily forgotten concepts.

例如用户对知识点 A 掌握薄弱，在观看课程时多次提问并倒退进度条反复观看，则 AI 可针对该知识点生成具有针对性小测、笔记和作业，辅助用户更牢固地掌握知识。 For example, if a user struggles with concept A, asking multiple questions and rewinding repeatedly, AI generates targeted quizzes, notes, and assignments for that specific concept to help the user master it more solidly.

大模型能力拐点 × 创作者经济爆发 × 终身学习刚需Convergence of structural drivers
LLM capability inflection × Creator economy boom × Lifelong learning demand
02 / 产品架构 02 / Product Architecture

四大核心模块，构建完整学习闭环 Four Core Modules, A Complete Learning Loop

从课程编排到实时伴学，从插件生态到 AI 内容生成，Lemma AI 覆盖学习的每一个环节。 From course orchestration to real-time companionship, from plugin ecosystem to AI content generation, Lemma AI covers every aspect of the learning journey.

M1

千人千面的智能课程编排引擎Personalized Course Orchestration Engine

输入用户的学习目标、当前知识水平、可用时间、偏好语言等，AI 检索全网优质学习资源，基于知识图谱和教学法原则，自动编排为体系化、精确到每日任务的个性化课程计划。 Input: learning goals, current knowledge level, available time, language preferences. AI retrieves quality resources across the web and orchestrates them into systematic, day-by-day personalized course plans based on knowledge graphs and pedagogical principles.

输出类 Coursera 体验的完整课程 — 每一课包含教学视频、讲义/幻灯片、课后小测、笔记模板、作业。若用户未在预定时间内完成某单元，系统自动动态重排后续课程日程。 Output: Coursera-style complete courses — each lesson includes teaching videos, notes/slides, quizzes, note templates, and assignments. If a user falls behind schedule, the system automatically reschedules subsequent lessons.

M2

实时 AI Copilot 伴学Real-time AI Copilot

用户在观看视频课程时，可随时暂停并在右侧 Copilot 交互区提问。关键技术差异：得益于底层对视频内容的深度语义理解，用户无需补充任何上下文，可直接引用时间戳提问。 Users can pause anytime and ask questions in the Copilot panel. Key technical differentiation: thanks to deep semantic understanding of video content, users can reference timestamps directly without providing additional context.

延伸能力：AI 基于对整套课程及用户个人学习画像的理解，主动识别薄弱知识点（如用户多次就同一概念提问、反复倒退进度条），并针对性生成强化练习、笔记和小测。 Extended capability: AI identifies weak knowledge points based on understanding of the entire course and user learning profile (e.g., repeated questions on the same concept, frequent rewinding), and generates targeted reinforcement exercises, notes, and quizzes.

M3

AI Native 插件市场AI-Native Plugin Marketplace

Copilot 不只是一个 ChatBot — 它是一个可扩展的教学工具平台。英语词汇场景调用"单词听写"插件、数学场景调用"交互式坐标系画板"、文科场景调用古诗/课文默写插件、通用场景支持多题型自动生成。 Copilot is not just a ChatBot — it's an extensible teaching tool platform. English vocabulary triggers dictation plugins, math scenarios trigger interactive coordinate canvases, humanities trigger poetry/text dictation, and universal scenarios support multi-format question generation.

开放生态（规划中）：后续开放 Plugin 开发规范，允许第三方开发者和教育创作者共建插件市场 — 形成"内容生态 + 工具生态"双飞轮。 Open ecosystem (planned): Plugin development specs will be released, allowing third-party developers and educational creators to co-build the marketplace — forming a "content ecosystem + tool ecosystem" dual flywheel.

M4

完整的 AI Native 生态Complete AI-Native Ecosystem

得益于 AI 对整套课程及用户个人画像的理解，AI 不仅可以找到最适合用户的学习课程和路径，还可以针对用户的痛点、薄弱点、知识本身的重点、易忘点等核心信息进行针对性的内容生成。 With AI's understanding of the entire course curriculum and the user's personal profile, it not only finds the most suitable learning paths but also generates targeted content addressing user pain points, weak areas, key knowledge points, and easily forgotten concepts.

例如用户对知识点 A 掌握薄弱，在观看课程时多次提问并倒退进度条反复观看，则 AI 可针对该知识点生成具有针对性小测、笔记和作业，辅助用户更牢固地掌握知识。 For example, if a user struggles with concept A, asking multiple questions and rewinding repeatedly, AI generates targeted quizzes, notes, and assignments for that specific concept to help the user master it more solidly.

03 / 战略差异化 03 / Strategic Differentiation

AIGC-Only vs. AI-Augmented：行业范式之争 AIGC-Only vs. AI-Augmented: The Paradigm Divide

当前 AI 教育赛道存在两条截然不同的路径。路径 A 以 AI 完全替代人类教师；路径 B 以 AI 赋能人类内容。Lemma AI 坚定选择路径 B。 Two fundamentally different paths exist in AI education. Path A replaces human teachers entirely with AI; Path B empowers human content with AI. Lemma AI firmly chooses Path B.

维度Dimension 路径 A：AIGC-OnlyPath A: AIGC-Only 路径 B：AI-Augmented（Lemma AI）Path B: AI-Augmented (Lemma AI)
核心逻辑Core Logic 用 AI 替代人类教师，完全生成教学内容Replace human teachers with AI, fully generate content 以全球优质人类创作内容为基底，用 AI 将其转化为个性化交互体验Build on quality human-created content globally, transform it into personalized interactive experiences with AI
与创作者的关系Creator Relationship 对抗 — 与 YouTube 教育博主、Coursera 讲师、私人教师直接竞争Competitive — directly competes with YouTube educators, Coursera instructors, private tutors 共生 — 为创作者赋能，扩大其内容的触达与价值Symbiotic — empowers creators, expanding their content reach and value
可覆盖市场Addressable Market 仅覆盖"愿意相信 AI 生成内容优于人类教师"的细分用户Only covers users willing to believe AI content surpasses human teachers 覆盖所有存量和增量的人类创作内容 — 市场天花板根本性更高Covers all existing and future human-created content — fundamentally higher market ceiling
内容质量天花板Content Quality Ceiling Lemma AI — 智能学习平台 | AI-Native Learning Platform

01 / 项目摘要 01 / Summary

我们不生成内容，我们赋能内容 We don't generate content, we empower it

区别于竞品以 AI 完全替代人类教师的路径，Lemma AI 选择站在全球数百万优质创作者一侧，将静态、孤立的学习资源转化为动态、交互式的个性化学习体验。这一"赋能而非对抗"的战略，使我们的可覆盖市场（TAM）远大于任何 AIGC-only 的竞争者。 Unlike competitors who aim to fully replace human teachers with AI, Lemma AI stands alongside millions of quality content creators worldwide, transforming static, isolated learning resources into dynamic, interactive personalized learning experiences. This "empower rather than compete" strategy gives us a TAM far greater than any AIGC-only competitor.

01

智能课程编排Smart Course Orchestration

AI 检索全网优质学习资源（YouTube、B站、Coursera、PDF、论文等），基于知识图谱和教学法原则，自动编排为体系化、精确到每日任务的个性化课程计划。AI retrieves quality learning resources across the web (YouTube, Bilibili, Coursera, PDFs, papers), and orchestrates them into systematic, day-by-day personalized course plans based on knowledge graphs and pedagogical principles.

02

实时 AI Copilot 伴学Real-time AI Copilot

用户在观看视频课程时可随时暂停并提问。得益于视频级深度语义理解，用户无需补充上下文，可直接引用时间戳提问，获得基于该视频片段的精确解答。Users can pause and ask questions anytime while watching video courses. Thanks to video-level deep semantic understanding, users can reference timestamps directly without adding context, receiving precise answers based on the video segment.

03

AI Native 插件生态AI-Native Plugin Ecosystem

Copilot 不只是一个 ChatBot — 它是一个可扩展的教学工具平台。从英语词汇听写到交互式坐标系画板，通过插件化架构使平台能力无限扩展，覆盖全场景需求。Copilot is not just a ChatBot — it's an extensible teaching tool platform. From English vocabulary dictation to interactive coordinate plane canvases, the plugin architecture enables infinite platform capability expansion across all scenarios.

02 / 产品架构 02 / Product Architecture

四大核心模块，构建完整学习闭环 Four Core Modules, A Complete Learning Loop

从课程编排到实时伴学，从插件生态到 AI 内容生成，Lemma AI 覆盖学习的每一个环节。 From course orchestration to real-time companionship, from plugin ecosystem to AI content generation, Lemma AI covers every aspect of the learning journey.

M1

千人千面的智能课程编排引擎Personalized Course Orchestration Engine

输入用户的学习目标、当前知识水平、可用时间、偏好语言等，AI 检索全网优质学习资源，基于知识图谱和教学法原则，自动编排为体系化、精确到每日任务的个性化课程计划。 Input: learning goals, current knowledge level, available time, language preferences. AI retrieves quality resources across the web and orchestrates them into systematic, day-by-day personalized course plans based on knowledge graphs and pedagogical principles.

输出类 Coursera 体验的完整课程 — 每一课包含教学视频、讲义/幻灯片、课后小测、笔记模板、作业。若用户未在预定时间内完成某单元，系统自动动态重排后续课程日程。 Output: Coursera-style complete courses — each lesson includes teaching videos, notes/slides, quizzes, note templates, and assignments. If a user falls behind schedule, the system automatically reschedules subsequent lessons.

M2

实时 AI Copilot 伴学Real-time AI Copilot

用户在观看视频课程时，可随时暂停并在右侧 Copilot 交互区提问。关键技术差异：得益于底层对视频内容的深度语义理解，用户无需补充任何上下文，可直接引用时间戳提问。 Users can pause anytime and ask questions in the Copilot panel. Key technical differentiation: thanks to deep semantic understanding of video content, users can reference timestamps directly without providing additional context.

延伸能力：AI 基于对整套课程及用户个人学习画像的理解，主动识别薄弱知识点（如用户多次就同一概念提问、反复倒退进度条），并针对性生成强化练习、笔记和小测。 Extended capability: AI identifies weak knowledge points based on understanding of the entire course and user learning profile (e.g., repeated questions on the same concept, frequent rewinding), and generates targeted reinforcement exercises, notes, and quizzes.

M3

AI Native 插件市场AI-Native Plugin Marketplace

Copilot 不只是一个 ChatBot — 它是一个可扩展的教学工具平台。英语词汇场景调用"单词听写"插件、数学场景调用"交互式坐标系画板"、文科场景调用古诗/课文默写插件、通用场景支持多题型自动生成。 Copilot is not just a ChatBot — it's an extensible teaching tool platform. English vocabulary triggers dictation plugins, math scenarios trigger interactive coordinate canvases, humanities trigger poetry/text dictation, and universal scenarios support multi-format question generation.

开放生态（规划中）：后续开放 Plugin 开发规范，允许第三方开发者和教育创作者共建插件市场 — 形成"内容生态 + 工具生态"双飞轮。 Open ecosystem (planned): Plugin development specs will be released, allowing third-party developers and educational creators to co-build the marketplace — forming a "content ecosystem + tool ecosystem" dual flywheel.

M4

完整的 AI Native 生态Complete AI-Native Ecosystem

得益于 AI 对整套课程及用户个人画像的理解，AI 不仅可以找到最适合用户的学习课程和路径，还可以针对用户的痛点、薄弱点、知识本身的重点、易忘点等核心信息进行针对性的内容生成。 With AI's understanding of the entire course curriculum and the user's personal profile, it not only finds the most suitable learning paths but also generates targeted content addressing user pain points, weak areas, key knowledge points, and easily forgotten concepts.

例如用户对知识点 A 掌握薄弱，在观看课程时多次提问并倒退进度条反复观看，则 AI 可针对该知识点生成具有针对性小测、笔记和作业，辅助用户更牢固地掌握知识。 For example, if a user struggles with concept A, asking multiple questions and rewinding repeatedly, AI generates targeted quizzes, notes, and assignments for that specific concept to help the user master it more solidly.

用户在观看视频课程时可随时暂停并提问。得益于视频级深度语义理解，用户无需补充上下文，可直接引用时间戳提问，获得基于该视频片段的精确解答。Users can pause and ask questions anytime while watching video courses. Thanks to video-level deep semantic understanding, users can reference timestamps directly without adding context, receiving precise answers based on the video segment.

03

AI Native 插件生态AI-Native Plugin Ecosystem

Copilot 不只是一个 ChatBot — 它是一个可扩展的教学工具平台。从英语词汇听写到交互式坐标系画板，通过插件化架构使平台能力无限扩展，覆盖全场景需求。Copilot is not just a ChatBot — it's an extensible teaching tool platform. From English vocabulary dictation to interactive coordinate plane canvases, the plugin architecture enables infinite platform capability expansion across all scenarios.

02 / 产品架构 02 / Product Architecture

四大核心模块，构建完整学习闭环 Four Core Modules, A Complete Learning Loop

从课程编排到实时伴学，从插件生态到 AI 内容生成，Lemma AI 覆盖学习的每一个环节。 From course orchestration to real-time companionship, from plugin ecosystem to AI content generation, Lemma AI covers every aspect of the learning journey.

M1

千人千面的智能课程编排引擎Personalized Course Orchestration Engine

输入用户的学习目标、当前知识水平、可用时间、偏好语言等，AI 检索全网优质学习资源，基于知识图谱和教学法原则，自动编排为体系化、精确到每日任务的个性化课程计划。 Input: learning goals, current knowledge level, available time, language preferences. AI retrieves quality resources across the web and orchestrates them into systematic, day-by-day personalized course plans based on knowledge graphs and pedagogical principles.

输出类 Coursera 体验的完整课程 — 每一课包含教学视频、讲义/幻灯片、课后小测、笔记模板、作业。若用户未在预定时间内完成某单元，系统自动动态重排后续课程日程。 Output: Coursera-style complete courses — each lesson includes teaching videos, notes/slides, quizzes, note templates, and assignments. If a user falls behind schedule, the system automatically reschedules subsequent lessons.

M2

实时 AI Copilot 伴学Real-time AI Copilot

用户在观看视频课程时，可随时暂停并在右侧 Copilot 交互区提问。关键技术差异：得益于底层对视频内容的深度语义理解，用户无需补充任何上下文，可直接引用时间戳提问。 Users can pause anytime and ask questions in the Copilot panel. Key technical differentiation: thanks to deep semantic understanding of video content, users can reference timestamps directly without providing additional context.

延伸能力：AI 基于对整套课程及用户个人学习画像的理解，主动识别薄弱知识点（如用户多次就同一概念提问、反复倒退进度条），并针对性生成强化练习、笔记和小测。 Extended capability: AI identifies weak knowledge points based on understanding of the entire course and user learning profile (e.g., repeated questions on the same concept, frequent rewinding), and generates targeted reinforcement exercises, notes, and quizzes.

M3

AI Native 插件市场AI-Native Plugin Marketplace

Copilot 不只是一个 ChatBot — 它是一个可扩展的教学工具平台。英语词汇场景调用"单词听写"插件、数学场景调用"交互式坐标系画板"、文科场景调用古诗/课文默写插件、通用场景支持多题型自动生成。 Copilot is not just a ChatBot — it's an extensible teaching tool platform. English vocabulary triggers dictation plugins, math scenarios trigger interactive coordinate canvases, humanities trigger poetry/text dictation, and universal scenarios support multi-format question generation.

开放生态（规划中）：后续开放 Plugin 开发规范，允许第三方开发者和教育创作者共建插件市场 — 形成"内容生态 + 工具生态"双飞轮。 Open ecosystem (planned): Plugin development specs will be released, allowing third-party developers and educational creators to co-build the marketplace — forming a "content ecosystem + tool ecosystem" dual flywheel.

M4

完整的 AI Native 生态Complete AI-Native Ecosystem

得益于 AI 对整套课程及用户个人画像的理解，AI 不仅可以找到最适合用户的学习课程和路径，还可以针对用户的痛点、薄弱点、知识本身的重点、易忘点等核心信息进行针对性的内容生成。 With AI's understanding of the entire course curriculum and the user's personal profile, it not only finds the most suitable learning paths but also generates targeted content addressing user pain points, weak areas, key knowledge points, and easily forgotten concepts.

例如用户对知识点 A 掌握薄弱，在观看课程时多次提问并倒退进度条反复观看，则 AI 可针对该知识点生成具有针对性小测、笔记和作业，辅助用户更牢固地掌握知识。 For example, if a user struggles with concept A, asking multiple questions and rewinding repeatedly, AI generates targeted quizzes, notes, and assignments for that specific concept to help the user master it more solidly.

03 / 战略差异化 03 / Strategic Differentiation

AIGC-Only vs. AI-Augmented：行业范式之争 AIGC-Only vs. AI-Augmented: The Paradigm Divide

当前 AI 教育赛道存在两条截然不同的路径。路径 A 以 AI 完全替代人类教师；路径 B 以 AI 赋能人类内容。Lemma AI 坚定选择路径 B。 Two fundamentally different paths exist in AI education. Path A replaces human teachers entirely with AI; Path B empowers human content with AI. Lemma AI firmly chooses Path B.

Copilot 不只是一个 ChatBot — 它是一个可扩展的教学工具平台。英语词汇场景调用"单词听写"插件、数学场景调用"交互式坐标系画板"、文科场景调用古诗/课文默写插件、通用场景支持多题型自动生成。 Copilot is not just a ChatBot — it's an extensible teaching tool platform. English vocabulary triggers dictation plugins, math scenarios trigger interactive coordinate canvases, humanities trigger poetry/text dictation, and universal scenarios support multi-format question generation.

开放生态（规划中）：后续开放 Plugin 开发规范，允许第三方开发者和教育创作者共建插件市场 — 形成"内容生态 + 工具生态"双飞轮。 Open ecosystem (planned): Plugin development specs will be released, allowing third-party developers and educational creators to co-build the marketplace — forming a "content ecosystem + tool ecosystem" dual flywheel.

M4

完整的 AI Native 生态Complete AI-Native Ecosystem

得益于 AI 对整套课程及用户个人画像的理解，AI 不仅可以找到最适合用户的学习课程和路径，还可以针对用户的痛点、薄弱点、知识本身的重点、易忘点等核心信息进行针对性的内容生成。 With AI's understanding of the entire course curriculum and the user's personal profile, it not only finds the most suitable learning paths but also generates targeted content addressing user pain points, weak areas, key knowledge points, and easily forgotten concepts.

例如用户对知识点 A 掌握薄弱，在观看课程时多次提问并倒退进度条反复观看，则 AI 可针对该知识点生成具有针对性小测、笔记和作业，辅助用户更牢固地掌握知识。 For example, if a user struggles with concept A, asking multiple questions and rewinding repeatedly, AI generates targeted quizzes, notes, and assignments for that specific concept to help the user master it more solidly.

01 / 项目摘要 01 / Summary

我们不生成内容，我们赋能内容 We don't generate content, we empower it

区别于竞品以 AI 完全替代人类教师的路径，Lemma AI 选择站在全球数百万优质创作者一侧，将静态、孤立的学习资源转化为动态、交互式的个性化学习体验。这一"赋能而非对抗"的战略，使我们的可覆盖市场（TAM）远大于任何 AIGC-only 的竞争者。 Unlike competitors who aim to fully replace human teachers with AI, Lemma AI stands alongside millions of quality content creators worldwide, transforming static, isolated learning resources into dynamic, interactive personalized learning experiences. This "empower rather than compete" strategy gives us a TAM far greater than any AIGC-only competitor.

01

智能课程编排Smart Course Orchestration

AI 检索全网优质学习资源（YouTube、B站、Coursera、PDF、论文等），基于知识图谱和教学法原则，自动编排为体系化、精确到每日任务的个性化课程计划。AI retrieves quality learning resources across the web (YouTube, Bilibili, Coursera, PDFs, papers), and orchestrates them into systematic, day-by-day personalized course plans based on knowledge graphs and pedagogical principles.

02

实时 AI Copilot 伴学Real-time AI Copilot

用户在观看视频课程时可随时暂停并提问。得益于视频级深度语义理解，用户无需补充上下文，可直接引用时间戳提问，获得基于该视频片段的精确解答。Users can pause and ask questions anytime while watching video courses. Thanks to video-level deep semantic understanding, users can reference timestamps directly without adding context, receiving precise answers based on the video segment.

03

AI Native 插件生态AI-Native Plugin Ecosystem

Copilot 不只是一个 ChatBot — 它是一个可扩展的教学工具平台。从英语词汇听写到交互式坐标系画板，通过插件化架构使平台能力无限扩展，覆盖全场景需求。Copilot is not just a ChatBot — it's an extensible teaching tool platform. From English vocabulary dictation to interactive coordinate plane canvases, the plugin architecture enables infinite platform capability expansion across all scenarios.

02 / 产品架构 02 / Product Architecture

四大核心模块，构建完整学习闭环 Four Core Modules, A Complete Learning Loop

从课程编排到实时伴学，从插件生态到 AI 内容生成，Lemma AI 覆盖学习的每一个环节。 From course orchestration to real-time companionship, from plugin ecosystem to AI content generation, Lemma AI covers every aspect of the learning journey.

M1

千人千面的智能课程编排引擎Personalized Course Orchestration Engine

输入用户的学习目标、当前知识水平、可用时间、偏好语言等，AI 检索全网优质学习资源，基于知识图谱和教学法原则，自动编排为体系化、精确到每日任务的个性化课程计划。 Input: learning goals, current knowledge level, available time, language preferences. AI retrieves quality resources across the web and orchestrates them into systematic, day-by-day personalized course plans based on knowledge graphs and pedagogical principles.

输出类 Coursera 体验的完整课程 — 每一课包含教学视频、讲义/幻灯片、课后小测、笔记模板、作业。若用户未在预定时间内完成某单元，系统自动动态重排后续课程日程。 Output: Coursera-style complete courses — each lesson includes teaching videos, notes/slides, quizzes, note templates, and assignments. If a user falls behind schedule, the system automatically reschedules subsequent lessons.

M2

Key technical differentiation: thanks to deep semantic understanding of video content, users can reference timestamps directly without providing additional context.

延伸能力：AI 基于对整套课程及用户个人学习画像的理解，主动识别薄弱知识点（如用户多次就同一概念提问、反复倒退进度条），并针对性生成强化练习、笔记和小测。 Extended capability: AI identifies weak knowledge points based on understanding of the entire course and user learning profile (e.g., repeated questions on the same concept, frequent rewinding), and generates targeted reinforcement exercises, notes, and quizzes.

01 / 项目摘要 01 / Summary

我们不生成内容，我们赋能内容 We don't generate content, we empower it

区别于竞品以 AI 完全替代人类教师的路径，Lemma AI 选择站在全球数百万优质创作者一侧，将静态、孤立的学习资源转化为动态、交互式的个性化学习体验。这一"赋能而非对抗"的战略，使我们的可覆盖市场（TAM）远大于任何 AIGC-only 的竞争者。 Unlike competitors who aim to fully replace human teachers with AI, Lemma AI stands alongside millions of quality content creators worldwide, transforming static, isolated learning resources into dynamic, interactive personalized learning experiences. This "empower rather than compete" strategy gives us a TAM far greater than any AIGC-only competitor.

01

智能课程编排Smart Course Orchestration

AI 检索全网优质学习资源（YouTube、B站、Coursera、PDF、论文等），基于知识图谱和教学法原则，自动编排为体系化、精确到每日任务的个性化课程计划。AI retrieves quality learning resources across the web (YouTube, Bilibili, Coursera, PDFs, papers), and orchestrates them into systematic, day-by-day personalized course plans based on knowledge graphs and pedagogical principles.

02

实时 AI Copilot 伴学Real-time AI Copilot

用户在观看视频课程时可随时暂停并提问。得益于视频级深度语义理解，用户无需补充上下文，可直接引用时间戳提问，获得基于该视频片段的精确解答。Users can pause and ask questions anytime while watching video courses. Thanks to video-level deep semantic understanding, users can reference timestamps directly without adding context, receiving precise answers based on the video segment.

03

AI Native 插件生态AI-Native Plugin Ecosystem

Copilot 不只是一个 ChatBot — 它是一个可扩展的教学工具平台。从英语词汇听写到交互式坐标系画板，通过插件化架构使平台能力无限扩展，覆盖全场景需求。Copilot is not just a ChatBot — it's an extensible teaching tool platform. From English vocabulary dictation to interactive coordinate plane canvases, the plugin architecture enables infinite platform capability expansion across all scenarios.

02 / 产品架构 02 / Product Architecture

四大核心模块，构建完整学习闭环 Four Core Modules, A Complete Learning Loop

从课程编排到实时伴学，从插件生态到 AI 内容生成，Lemma AI 覆盖学习的每一个环节。 From course orchestration to real-time companionship, from plugin ecosystem to AI content generation, Lemma AI covers every aspect of the learning journey.

M1

千人千面的智能课程编排引擎Personalized Course Orchestration Engine

输入用户的学习目标、当前知识水平、可用时间、偏好语言等，AI 检索全网优质学习资源，基于知识图谱和教学法原则，自动编排为体系化、精确到每日任务的个性化课程计划。 Input: learning goals, current knowledge level, available time, language preferences. AI retrieves quality resources across the web and orchestrates them into systematic, day-by-day personalized course plans based on knowledge graphs and pedagogical principles.

输出类 Coursera 体验的完整课程 — 每一课包含教学视频、讲义/幻灯片、课后小测、笔记模板、作业。若用户未在预定时间内完成某单元，系统自动动态重排后续课程日程。 Output: Coursera-style complete courses — each lesson includes teaching videos, notes/slides, quizzes, note templates, and assignments. If a user falls behind schedule, the system automatically reschedules subsequent lessons.

M2

实时 AI Copilot 伴学Real-time AI Copilot

用户在观看视频课程时，可随时暂停并在右侧 Copilot 交互区提问。关键技术差异：得益于底层对视频内容的深度语义理解，用户无需补充任何上下文，可直接引用时间戳提问。 Users can pause anytime and ask questions in the Copilot panel. Key technical differentiation: thanks to deep semantic understanding of video content, users can reference timestamps directly without providing additional context.

延伸能力：AI 基于对整套课程及用户个人学习画像的理解，主动识别薄弱知识点（如用户多次就同一概念提问、反复倒退进度条），并针对性生成强化练习、笔记和小测。 Extended capability: AI identifies weak knowledge points based on understanding of the entire course and user learning profile (e.g., repeated questions on the same concept, frequent rewinding), and generates targeted reinforcement exercises, notes, and quizzes.

M3

AI Native 插件市场AI-Native Plugin Marketplace

Copilot 不只是一个 ChatBot — 它是一个可扩展的教学工具平台。英语词汇场景调用"单词听写"插件、数学场景调用"交互式坐标系画板"、文科场景调用古诗/课文默写插件、通用场景支持多题型自动生成。 Copilot is not just a ChatBot — it's an extensible teaching tool platform. English vocabulary triggers dictation plugins, math scenarios trigger interactive coordinate canvases, humanities trigger poetry/text dictation, and universal scenarios support multi-format question generation.

开放生态（规划中）：后续开放 Plugin 开发规范，允许第三方开发者和教育创作者共建插件市场 — 形成"内容生态 + 工具生态"双飞轮。 Open ecosystem (planned): Plugin development specs will be released, allowing third-party developers and educational creators to co-build the marketplace — forming a "content ecosystem + tool ecosystem" dual flywheel.

M4

完整的 AI Native 生态Complete AI-Native Ecosystem

得益于 AI 对整套课程及用户个人画像的理解，AI 不仅可以找到最适合用户的学习课程和路径，还可以针对用户的痛点、薄弱点、知识本身的重点、易忘点等核心信息进行针对性的内容生成。 With AI's understanding of the entire course curriculum and the user's personal profile, it not only finds the most suitable learning paths but also generates targeted content addressing user pain points, weak areas, key knowledge points, and easily forgotten concepts.

例如用户对知识点 A 掌握薄弱，在观看课程时多次提问并倒退进度条反复观看，则 AI 可针对该知识点生成具有针对性小测、笔记和作业，辅助用户更牢固地掌握知识。 For example, if a user struggles with concept A, asking multiple questions and rewinding repeatedly, AI generates targeted quizzes, notes, and assignments for that specific concept to help the user master it more solidly.

03 / 战略差异化 03 / Strategic Differentiation

AIGC-Only vs. AI-Augmented：行业范式之争 AIGC-Only vs. AI-Augmented: The Paradigm Divide

当前 AI 教育赛道存在两条截然不同的路径。路径 A 以 AI 完全替代人类教师；路径 B 以 AI 赋能人类内容。Lemma AI 坚定选择路径 B。 Two fundamentally different paths exist in AI education. Path A replaces human teachers entirely with AI; Path B empowers human content with AI. Lemma AI firmly chooses Path B.
